answer: part=0 fires=0 floods=0 came from the hull mesh trace writing record+34h = -1 and +30h = 0Ah on every hit, so R1 (00826F62) skipped R2..R10. The trace now walks the GeomMesh elements in 00723D60's order and copies element+4h / +8h (00723F62 / 00723F6C). Floods and fires add seconds through 9Eh (0093A4F0 water +34h, 0093A470 fire +38h). The damage-control tick 0093CA20 turns each elapsed second into WaterTickDamage (100) or FireTickDamage (40) damage and heals BodyRepairTickPercentage/100 * BodyRepairMultiplier of max per second. All three switches are ON.

steps.rule: the repair task constructor at unit+A20h: +2Ch <- settings+3B0h WaterTickDamage, +30h <- settings+3ACh FireTickDamage, +28h = 1.0, +24h = 0
hull step, heal = +28h * dt * settings+3B4h * max * settings+3D4h * modifier
water step over +34h at +2Ch, divisor settings+3C8h only at priority 4
fire step over +38h at +30h, divisor settings+3CCh only at priority 3
the heal goes through ApplyHealthDelta, which negates into 00879070
AddFireSeconds: water_s * +2Ch + fire_s * +30h above health notifies game+21A0h
